yearlyMessage: Focus on The Love of The Lord
intro: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus.
outro: You have spoken life into your day. Walk boldly in the love of the Lord. You are blessed, covered, and victorious.

days.verse: The Lord disciplines the one he loves.
days.teaching: Rod proves belonging. Month focus — Boundaries of Love — Discipline & Justice: Correction proves sonship. This week we carry "Love as the Highest Apologetic" (John 13:35). Deeper Love for All Humanity flows from being loved first. Let Hebrews 12:6 settle you: The Lord disciplines the one he loves.
days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Shed Your love abroad in my heart. Let me see people through the eyes of Jesus.
days.declaration: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today.
days.decree: I am a conduit of God’s love to humanity today. The Lord disciplines the one he loves. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Do one deliberate kindness for someone unlovable or overlooked.

Month focus — Boundaries of Love — Discipline & Justice: Correction proves sonship. This week we carry "Love as the Highest Apologetic" (John 13:35). days.verse: Those whom I love I rebuke.
days.teaching: Earnest, then repent. Month focus — Boundaries of Love — Discipline & Justice: Correction proves sonship. This week we carry "Love as the Highest Apologetic" (John 13:35). Wisdom for the Abundant Life flows from being loved first. Let Revelation 3:19 settle you: Those whom I love I rebuke.

days.action: Review one money choice; give or save as worship today.

days.prayer: Heavenly Father, we thank You for this brand-new day and the opportunity to gather as family in Your presence. Your mercies are new every morning. Forgive us our sins and trespasses, and we forgive all who trespassed against us. We stand cleansed by the blood of Jesus. I put on the whole armour of God. days.declaration: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today.
days.decree: I enforce the victory of the cross over my life and family today. Yet he was merciful. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
days.action: Speak Ephesians 6:10-11 aloud; cancel one fear by name.
